info.title: Warden API
info.description: Every response is an envelope {data, error, meta}. Field names are snake_case, timestamps RFC 3339 (UTC), ids UUIDs unless noted. Unknown JSON fields are rejected with 422. Request bodies are limited to 1 MiB.

bearer.description: An OIDC access token (JWT), or an API token wdn_<prefix>_<secret>. API tokens act as their creator, are bound to one project, and may only call: POST /orgs/{org_id}/projects/{project_id}/scans, POST /orgs/{org_id}/scans/{scan_id}/start and /cancel, GET /orgs/{org_id}/scans/{scan_id} and /gate (scope scan:write); GET /orgs/{org_id}/issues and /issues/{issue_id} (scope issues:read). Any other route is 403 TOKEN_SCOPE; another org or project is 404. Each token is limited to 60 requests per minute (429 with Retry-After). Roles listed in oidc.require_mfa_roles get 403 MFA_REQUIRED under /orgs/{org_id} unless the access token shows a second factor; API tokens are exempt.

mfa_required_orgs.description: Orgs this sign-in can't use: the caller's role there requires a second factor (oidc.require_mfa_roles) and the access token has none. Calls under those orgs return 403 MFA_REQUIRED.

via_token.description: The API token that created the scan, if any (created_by is the token's creator).

target.description: Image repository for image scans (no tag); empty for source scans.

image_ref.description: The image reference given at upload, for display (image scans only).

sbom.description: Present when the scan produced a CycloneDX SBOM that hasn't expired (see GET .../sbom).

kev.description: One of the issue's CVEs is in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

epss.description: Highest FIRST EPSS score of the issue's CVEs (probability of exploitation in 30 days).

version.description: Optimistic lock; send it back on transitions.

kev_added.description: Earliest date one of the CVEs was added to KEV.

kev_ransomware.description: KEV marks a CVE as known to be used in ransomware campaigns.

id.description: Numeric event id, as a string.
Numeric entry id, as a string.

title.description: Server-built text, e.g. "WEB-41 assigned to you".

match.description: At least one matcher. All given matchers must match.

path_glob.description: Doublestar glob: * and ? within a segment, ** across segments.

mttr_hours.description: Mean hours from creation to first fixed/verified, for issues first fixed in the window.

kev.description: Active issues with a CVE in KEV.

file_name.description: A .zip of source code (kind source) or a `docker save` .tar (kind image).

file_size.description: At most upload_max_mb MiB (source) or image_upload_max_mb MiB (image).

tools.description: Image scans only run trivy; any other tool is a 422.

target.description: Required for image scans: the image repository without tag or digest, e.g. ghcr.io/acme/api. Issues are tracked per target.

image_ref.description: Optional, image scans only: the full reference (tag or digest), shown on the scan.

assignee_id.description: Required (and only allowed) when to = assigned.

expires_at.description: risk_accepted only: required, within (now, now + 180 days].
Approve a risk acceptance only; may only shorten the requested expiry.

recompute_open.description: Reset due_at of active issues from their created_at.

TokenScope.description: scan:write: create, start, cancel and read scans and read the gate in the token's project. issues:read: list and read issues in the token's project.

last_used_at.description: Updated at most once a minute.

secret.description: The full token. Returned only here, once; Warden stores only a hash of it.

pass.description: False until the scan has finished, and always for failed or cancelled scans.

blocking.description: Active issues seen in this scan at or above fail_on (or in KEV with fail_on_kev), most severe first (at most 100).

kev.description: Active issues seen in this scan with a CVE in KEV.

Gate.description: counts: active issues (open, assigned, in_progress, reopened) seen in this scan. false_positive and risk_accepted issues never block.

mfa_roles.description: Roles that must sign in with a second factor, in addition to the server's oidc.require_mfa_roles.

allowed_email_domains.description: Only addresses at these domains can be added as members (exact match, case-insensitive). Empty: any domain.

keys_url.description: Pinned JWKS URL (oidc.jwks_url); null when discovered from the issuer.

console_url.description: Link to the identity provider's admin console (oidc.console_url).

error.description: Category of the last failed fetch (no error text: it can name internal hosts).

url.description: Presigned GET, valid for 5 minutes; served as an attachment.

LicenseAction.description: block: High issue (fails the default gate); review: Medium issue; allow: no issue.

deny.description: SPDX ids always blocked (overrides the category).

allow.description: SPDX ids never reported (overrides deny and the category). Must not overlap deny.

enabled.description: False when every category is allow and deny is empty: no license issues are created.

updated_at.description: When the publisher last updated the data, as recorded in the mirror.

loaded_at.description: When the worker last loaded it (null for trivy_db: Trivy reads the mirror directly).

stale.description: updated_at missing or older than 7 days.
